name: reporting-agent
description: Specialist agent for performance report generation, multi-round HITL revision, and Confluence publishing in the PerfPilot Agents framework. Owns the final-mile delivery pipeline: chart generation, Markdown report assembly, AI-driven report revision, and Confluence page creation with chart image attachments.

skills.name: Generate performance charts
skills.description: Generates performance chart images (response-time, throughput, error-rate, infrastructure PNGs) from test run data for inclusion in reports.

skills.name: Assemble structured Markdown performance test reports from templates
skills.description: Assembles structured Markdown performance test reports from configurable templates, embedding analysis results, chart references, and metadata.

skills.name: Discover revisable report sections and prepare revision context
skills.description: Discovers which sections of a generated report are revisable and prepares the context needed for AI-driven revision.

skills.name: AI-driven report section revision with human-in-the-loop feedback
skills.description: Performs AI-driven revision of report sections (executive summary, key observations, issues table) incorporating human-in-the-loop feedback for iterative refinement.

skills.name: Generate comparison reports analyzing multiple test runs side-by-side
skills.description: Generates comparison reports that analyze multiple test runs side-by-side, highlighting performance trends, regressions, and improvements.

skills.name: Create or update Confluence pages with report content
skills.description: Creates or updates Confluence wiki pages with the generated report content, handling page creation, content formatting, and versioning.

skills.name: Attach chart images to Confluence pages
skills.description: Uploads and attaches chart image files to Confluence pages, linking them to the appropriate report sections.

skills.name: Navigate Confluence spaces and search for existing pages
skills.description: Navigates Confluence spaces and searches for existing pages to determine where to publish reports or find prior test results.

skills.name: Manage report templates and chart color configurations
skills.description: Manages report templates (report_config.yaml), chart schema definitions (chart_schema.yaml), and chart color configurations (chart_colors.yaml).

report_pipeline.chart_generation: Response-time, throughput, error-rate, infrastructure PNG charts
report_pipeline.report_assembly: Template-driven Markdown report with embedded analysis + charts
report_pipeline.hitl_revision: Multi-round AI-driven revision of executive summary, key observations, issues table
